reuse.why: Routes every month-wide action through the existing shouldWriteMonthBudget predicate, but writes the saved-template test as a fresh SQL expression rather than sharing it (no helper existed for the positive form; statements.ts has only the negated inline variant).

duplication.why: The has_saved_template SQL expression (goal_def IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(JSON_EXTRACT(template_settings,'$.source'),'notes')='ui') is pasted into five separate queries, and the three near-identical average queries stay copies.

placement.why: The skip decision correctly lives in month-action.ts, but the definition of 'has a saved template' is spread through the SQL of each action in actions.ts instead of one query/helper.

scope.why: Changes are limited to the month-wide actions, the predicate and a focused test.

maintainability.why: The predicate simplification is good, but five copies of the template SQL, a has_saved_template typed boolean|0|1 with double comparison, and untyped extra columns in getBudgetData make the rule easy to drift.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied SQL fragment is verbatim (lightly reformatted), not disguised.

one_place.where: Hidden/group-hidden/template skip lands in shouldWriteMonthBudget (month-action.ts), but what counts as a saved template is defined five times in the SELECTs of getBudgetData, setZero, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg and set12MonthAvg in actions.ts.
